vocabulary.validation: caller input rejected before any guest started; `validation:<limit>` names a budget
vocabulary.exit(n): a guest exited with status n
vocabulary.trap:stack: a guest exhausted the call stack
vocabulary.limit:<budget>: a running guest exceeded a ResourceLimits budget
vocabulary.policy:<rule>: the host refused a result by policy
vocabulary.protocol: a guest exited 0 without honoring its contract
vocabulary.timeout: the host deadline stopped the job

surfaces.ts-worker: sdk/typescript createWorkerCompiler on the supported Deno worker runtime
surfaces.go: sdk/go with default options (the compiler on wazero's interpreter)
surfaces.launcher: bin/capnp-wasm under Wasmtime; compiler guests run as generator modules
surfaces.browser-direct: createCompiler in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
surfaces.browser-worker: createWorkerCompiler in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; `browser-worker@<engine>` keys hold one engine's departures
surfaces.studio: examples/browser/compiler.js in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
